description: Defines data structures and classes for labelled machine learning examples, including FeatureVector, LabelledExample, and TrainingData, used for training or prediction in media learning context.

classes.name: LabelledExample
classes.description: Represents a single training example with features, target value, and weight.

classes.name: TrainingData
classes.description: Holds a collection of labelled examples for training or prediction.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds a labelled example with its weight to the training data.

methods.name: DeDuplicate
methods.description: Returns a copy of training data with duplicate entries merged, summing their weights.
